text:
rachel: dropping a concise dump from today's exploratory run for speculative decode on a quant-13B variant. keeping it terse so folks can pick up.
rachel: experiment sketch: variable candidate fanout (2..6) decided by a cheap prefix probe; fast-path is q13b-int8-slice, rescoring via a tiny cross-encoder fp16 (forward-only), and an optional rescoring-only mode (no autoreg fallback) to bound quality recovery.
omid: what trigger heuristics did you try?
rachel: composite trigger used: windowed-surprisal over last N tokens, mean_pairwise_js, and an LLR-style score across top candidates. Also experimented with an "embedding-divergence" signal using pooled last-layer vectors to spot candidate collusion.
tess: any numbers?
rachel: micro-run (3k paired samples vs fp16 baseline): median end-to-end latency ~2.6x faster, including rescoring ~2.1x. p95 down ~1.7x. Automated metrics: MMLU paired delta ~-0.55%, SQuAD EM ~-0.8% on this dev slice. Human spot-check (120 pairs) flagged 10 truncation-ish answers and 6 hallucinations where all candidates agreed; rescoring-only recovered ~4/6 hallucinations, full fallback fixed 5/6.
omid: interesting. embedding-divergence help?
rachel: yes, pooled-vector cosine worked well to detect collusion that token-consensus missed. Adding embedding-divergence as an OR-trigger reduced unanimous-hallucinations in the spot-checks by ~65% with a small fallback-rate bump.
dev-bot: job jd-10011 created, artifacts at /artifacts/spec/3612345678/ (paired_metrics, candidate_traces, pooled_vecs).

rachel: command used for reproducibility:
```
redwood-evals run --suite spec-varfanout:v1
  --model q13b-int8-fast --fallback fp16-13b-full
  --spec-min 2 --spec-max 6 --prefix-probe distill8
  --surprisal-window 10 --js-thresh 0.12 --llr-thresh 0.85
  --embed-div-thresh 0.18 --rescoring-model fp16-xenc --rescoring-only false
  --samples 3000 --tag varfanout-embed-probe
```

mika: did you try any diversity tricks to avoid candidate collapse?
rachel: quick hack: tiny stochastic perturbation to logits (gaussian noise scaled by 0.01) for first 6 tokens and a sampling fallback for tokens with low candidate-divergence. improved diversity at cost of slightly higher variance. Also tried a "prune-by-js" stage after token 40 to retire low-scoring candidates and free KV memory.
omid: runtime cost for pooled-vector calc? feasible in prod?
rachel: microbench says pooled-vector extraction + cosine for up to 6 candidates is ~0.02-0.04x of a full decode if batched. cheap enough to run as a selective feature flag.
tess: cost math?
rachel: rough infra estimate: raw fast-path reduces per-token infra spend ~40%; rescoring-only adds back ~8-10% depending on candidate count; net 30-35% saving in current runs. Full fallback frequency matters a lot.
ops-bot: created ticket RED-2807: "varfanout spec decode canary + pooled-vec capture" https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2807

omid: suggested follow-ups: 1) run 10k stratified paired holdout (code, qa, cot, math), 2) try rescoring-only ablation to quantify upper-bound recovery, 3) implement early-accept rule: skip rescoring if top-candidate prob>0.94 and pooled-divergence<0.04 and LLR>1.5.
rachel: will schedule 10k. also plan to log per-request traces: pool_size_over_time, surprisal_trace, mean_pairwise_js, pooled_cosines, triggers_fired. keep payload compact.
mika: human eval plan? we need longform COT and rare-entity QA coverage.
rachel: yes: 1k paired human eval focused on longchain reasoning + rare entities; labelers mark "truncation", "hallucination", "acceptable". pairwise majority vote. Block rollout if MMLU drops >1.0% with paired bootstrap p<0.01 OR hallucination_rate_for_rare_entities increases >0.35%.
omid: small runtime idea: implement "collapse-detect" that forces increased temp/stochasticity if top-3 token overlap >0.9 for 6 tokens. should be cheap and avoid unanimous wrong answers.
tess: good. also capture a small live sample (0.2% requests) with full candidate traces and logits for offline analysis.
ops-bot: reserved canary slice RED-2807-slice: 3% dedicated for 48h pending 10k run.

rachel: next steps checklist: - kick 10k paired run overnight - add rescoring-only ablation - prototype collapse-detect feature flag - prepare 1k human eval sheet - open PR with eval config + rollback gates. tagging @omid @tess @mika for review. :thumbsup:
